goal: Stop unconditional debug log spam when assembling block templates
Helps node operators running services that build templates frequently, such as Electrum servers
reviewability: Nothing known that would invalidate a review
agreement: Unaddressed objection: adding a new log category for a single line is excessive (l0rinc)
Suggests using an existing category like mempool instead and questions test utility (l0rinc)

categories.name: mining
why: P4 because silencing template assembly logs reduces debug log spam for operators making frequent templates
Has no effect on block template validity, accounting, or mining performance
